lines.text: In visions of God, the LORD set Ezekiel on a very high mountain, where a bronze-like man stood in a gateway.
The man held a linen cord and a measuring rod, and measured the wall one rod thick and one rod high.
The man climbed the steps of the gate facing west and measured it, and its pillars had palm trees.
He led Ezekiel into the inner court through the south gate, where a chamber was for washing the burnt offering.
The north-facing chamber was for the altar's priests, sons of Levi, the only Levites who may minister before the LORD.
